comment: Sovereign Router v0.5 starting model set, exactly per spec v0.5.3 'Starting model set' table. No API keys here — provider keys live as mode-600 files in the state dir (keys/<provider>.key). spend_alert_usd is an alert level, never a cap. v0.5.5 (2026-11-07): rescue_eligible removed from premium/gpt-5.5 — the free-first / paid-spillway waterfall in the gateway supersedes the v0.5.3 rescue pin (owner ruling 2026-11-07). v0.5.6 (2026-11-07): SiliconFlow added — siliconflow/glm-5.3 ENABLED in the paid lane at half of Z.ai direct (NON-SENSITIVE ONLY, spillway_sensitive_excluded) and siliconflow/deepseek-v4-pro present but DISABLED; gateway v0.5.6 enforces the per-model sensitive exclusion in every pass. v0.5.7 (2026-11-09): Groq moved to Developer-plan limits/prices (owner top-up; docs-verified); Ollama TPD seed corrected 400k -> 10M (the seed, not Ollama, caused the 2026-11-09 05:11 self-throttle); two Hugging Face probe entries added DISABLED + non-sensitive-only (owner approval 2026-11-09). v0.5.8 candidate (2026-11-12): three additions — cerebras/gpt-oss-120b (direct, trial-tier key, reasoning_effort=low pinned), novita/gpt-oss-120b (cheapest 120B route), zai/glm-4.7-flash ($0 public-free, 200K ctx, throttles under load). NVIDIA NIM probed same day and NOT added: its free endpoint did not answer a trivial request within 90s. 2026-11-12 staging: +5 DISABLED entries awaiting keys — mistral/mistral-large, mistral/codestral (owner signup pending), google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite (ENABLED 2026-11-12 — key minted in the owner's account; 3.8-flash timed out on probes), cloudflare/gpt-oss-120b + cloudflare/glm-4.7-flash (Workers-AI-scoped token pending). All public-only-free.

models.notes: Spec: quality 2, small prompts only — Groq free tier is 8k tokens/min per model, so the tpm limit makes the router skip it for large (e.g. Hermes) prompts instead of waiting. 2026-11-09: owner moved Groq to the Developer (paid) plan — limits/prices are now the Developer-plan figures from Groq's own docs models page (checked 2026-11-09). Lane stays private-free (owner decision 2026-11-09): the lane marks Groq's no-training data posture; prices are carried so spend accounting is real.

Spec: quality 4, small prompts only (8k tokens/min Groq free limit). 2026-11-09: owner moved Groq to the Developer (paid) plan — limits/prices are now the Developer-plan figures from Groq's own docs models page (checked 2026-11-09). Lane stays private-free (owner decision 2026-11-09): the lane marks Groq's no-training data posture; prices are carried so spend accounting is real.

Spec registry name qwen3.8-27b (v0.3 registry.json spelling); quality 3, small prompts only. 2026-11-09: Qwen3.8-27B is a Preview model on Groq; Developer-plan price $0.80/$4.00 per 1M and 250K TPM / 1K RPM from Groq's docs models page (checked 2026-11-09). 2026-11-09: owner moved Groq to the Developer (paid) plan — limits/prices are now the Developer-plan figures from Groq's own docs models page (checked 2026-11-09). Lane stays private-free (owner decision 2026-11-09): the lane marks Groq's no-training data posture; prices are carried so spend accounting is real.

Spec: private-free only because data_collection=deny is enforced via extra_body on every call. About 1,000 requests/day shared across clients (rpd). Code quality seeded 4 (it is a code model); other classes at the spec's flat 3. 2026-11-04: reasoning disabled via extra_body - direct probes showed this endpoint's hidden reasoning expands to consume ANY budget (512-8192) on most code prompts, returning finish=length with zero content; OpenRouter ignores reasoning.max_tokens and effort caps for it but honours reasoning.enabled=false, after which it answers directly.

Spec: preview model, re-probe weekly. 512k context makes it the long-context free option (long-context quality seeded 4); other classes at the spec's flat 3. 2026-11-11: reasoning disabled via extra_body (same fix as north-mini 2026-11-04) — as the free lane's only 512k-context model it had become the sticky server for the Hermes agent sessions; its hidden reasoning consumed the whole output budget on final answers, returning reasoning-only/empty responses (Hermes 'No reply' incident 2026-11-11, and the morning's malformed-tool-call loops). OpenRouter honours the flag for this model — verified by probe 2026-11-11 (reasoning_len 0, finish=stop, full content). Incident: docs/incidents/2026-11-11-dots-3-reasoning-empty-responses.md.

Spec: $0.09/$0.18 per 1M, 262k configured context, quality '4 to 5' — seeded 5 for infra/code (its proven v0.3.3 canary work) and 4 elsewhere. Cached input billed at 20% ($0.018/1M). Spend alert $10/month, no cap.

Spec: $0.15/$0.60 per 1M, quality 4, spend alert $5/month (no cap). Daily token limit matches the Ollama Cloud plan behaviour observed 2026-10-31 (400k/day exhausted by 17 Hermes turns); rpd/rpm to be set from the plan page at deploy time. 2026-11-09 CORRECTION: the 400k/day figure was a router-side conservative seed, NOT an Ollama limit — the owner's Ollama console shows 50 requests / $0.07 total for Nov 1-9 with gpt-oss:120b under free usage. The seed caused the 05:11 self-throttle during the 2026-11-09 DeepInfra outage. Raised to 10M/day (effectively unseeded); a real Ollama ceiling will now surface as upstream errors + lane_dead alerts instead of a silent self-skip.

SiliconFlow (international, api.siliconflow.com) serving Z.ai's GLM-5.3 — the like-for-like probe's one clear price win (2026-11-07): exactly half of Z.ai direct on every component ($0.70 in / $0.13 cached / $2.20 out vs $1.40 / $0.26 / $4.40). Quality mirrored from zai/glm-5.3 (same model). NON-SENSITIVE ONLY: spillway_sensitive_excluded — SF's data posture graded UNCLEAR (training not contractually prohibited, retention unspecified, no ZDR/DPA), so the gateway never selects this entry for sensitive turns in any pass. Limits are SF's L0 (new-account) ceilings: 1,000 RPM / 40,000 TPM per account and model — a ~45k-token turn exceeds the TPM window and skips to DeepInfra by design; raise the limits as the account tier rises with spend. Prices read from OpenRouter's live SF endpoints and corroborated by two aggregators (SF's own pricing page is JS-rendered); confirm firsthand once the account key lands — checklist in the deploy record. Key file keys/siliconflow.key via the capture page; deployed keyless 2026-11-07 (skipped as provider_key_missing until the key lands).

Premium lane placeholder carried from v0.2.1 production (gpt-5.5 was 82 of the 104 premium requests in the live audit; claude-sonnet-4-6 took the rest and can be added as a second premium entry before Phase 3). PRICING IS A PLACEHOLDER — confirm against the provider price list before Phase 3; the premium monthly alert ($20 proposed) lives on the OpenClaw client policy. Only level 5 or explicit premium, only for clients with premium permission.

Direct DeepSeek (bypasses DeepInfra). Accounting at PEAK rates ($1.32 in / $0.044 cached / $3.96 out); off-peak (most of the MT day) is exactly half ($0.66 / $0.022 / $1.98). Peak windows 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays. Quality: reasoning 5 (HLE #8, 60.0%); code/infra 5 (V4 family already carries 5/5 in this registry via DeepInfra canary work); chat/long-context 4 (strong but not the fleet's proven classes). Key file keys/deepseek.key via the capture page. v0.5.5 (2026-11-07): the owner replaced the gpt-5.5-only rescue pin with the free-first / paid spillway — as a premium entry this model is reachable in the spillway pass in normal cost order.

Direct Z.ai pay-as-you-go (NOT the GLM Coding Plan, which is tool-restricted). Base path is /api/paas/v4 — /v1 returns 404 on this platform. Quality: reasoning 5 (HLE #6, 62.5%, best of the three newcomers); code 5 (GLM flagship coding line); chat/infra/long-context 4 (1M context, capable, but unproven in this fleet — raise from probe data). Latency seeded high: infra is primarily in China. Key file keys/zai.key via the capture page. v0.5.5 (2026-11-07): the owner replaced the gpt-5.5-only rescue pin with the free-first / paid spillway — as a premium entry this model is reachable in the spillway pass in normal cost order.

SiliconFlow serving DeepSeek V4 Pro — a second host for the premium step (probe 2026-11-07: output $1.50 beats DeepSeek direct off-peak $1.98; cache $0.135 is ~6x DeepSeek direct's off-peak $0.022, so it would win output-heavy turns only). DEPLOYED DISABLED (the Muse Spark pattern): enable only after the with-key checklist settles its price firsthand — SF's own model page suggests $1.50/$3.135 for this model ID vs the probe's $1.00/$1.50 OpenRouter read. NON-SENSITIVE ONLY: spillway_sensitive_excluded, same posture basis as siliconflow/glm-5.3. Limits are SF's L0 ceilings (1,000 RPM / 40,000 TPM). Quality mirrored from deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro (same model).

Meta Model API, STANDARD tier only (contributor tier lets Meta train on traffic; 1.1 has no contributor variant). Quality: reasoning 5 (HLE #7, 62.1%); chat 5 (Meta's flagship assistant model); code/infra/long-context 4. context_tokens 262144 is a SEED — UNVERIFIED, confirm against Meta's docs in the probe battery before enabling. Documented team limits 3,000 RPM / 4M TPM (not enforced in limits until deploy decision). DEPLOYED DISABLED 2026-11-05: the account key verifies (GET /v1/models 200) but chat returns 402 billing_not_configured until Jordan resolves the Meta team billing issue at dev.meta.ai — enable only after billing clears AND the probe battery passes. Key file keys/meta.key via the capture page. v0.5.5 (2026-11-07): the owner replaced the gpt-5.5-only rescue pin with the free-first / paid spillway — as a premium entry this model is reachable in the spillway pass in normal cost order.

Hugging Face Inference Providers route to Cerebras for gpt-oss-120b (provider pinned via the :cerebras suffix, per HF docs). Price from HF's own inference models catalog (read 2026-11-09): $0.35 in / $0.75 out per 1M — a speed premium over Groq direct ($0.15/$0.60); the catalog marks Cerebras fastest for this model (~1,074 tok/s vs Groq ~421). Quality mirrored from groq/gpt-oss-120b (same model). NON-SENSITIVE ONLY (spillway_sensitive_excluded): HF routes to third-party backends whose data posture varies by provider. Deployed DISABLED 2026-11-09 as a probe (owner approval 2026-11-09): enable only after the HF token lands as keys/huggingface.key and the benchmark battery passes. HF billing is pass-through (no markup) via the owner's HF account — a billing pool SEPARATE from the direct provider accounts. PROBE RESULT 2026-11-09 (CORRECTED same day — the first read was wrong): the route WORKS. Small turn 200 (0.16s at provider), tool-call turn 200 with well-formed arguments, 36,477-token turn 200. The morning's 403s were the probe client's fault: HF forwards the caller's User-Agent to the provider, and Cerebras/Groq Cloudflare bans the Python-urllib default UA (error 1010 HTML page naming the provider domain). SDK and httpx UAs pass — the gateway speaks httpx, so it was never affected. Cerebras prices do not appear in HF's usage estimated_cost (provider-dependent) — settle the real rate from HF billing after first serves. ENABLED 2026-11-09 on the owner's order, after fresh verification calls to both HF models passed. DISABLED 2026-11-11: this route served the default Hermes bot's agent session and leaked deliberation into user-visible replies, drifted tool argument shapes mid-batch, and confabulated an error report ('HTTP 500 Error in workflow' for what was a schema validation rejection). Probes the same day: its hidden reasoning burns ~2.2k tokens per turn and neither reasoning_effort=low nor reasoning.enabled=false is honoured on this route (finish=length, reasoning_len ~2,268). Same model remains available via groq/gpt-oss-120b, where reasoning.enabled=false IS honoured. Incident: SovereignRouter docs/incidents/2026-11-11-dots-3-reasoning-empty-responses.md addendum + Hermes-agent E-10.

Hugging Face Inference Providers route to DeepSeek V4 Flash — a separately-billed second route to the spillway workhorse (the 2026-11-09 outage: direct DeepInfra credits died at 04:48; this route bills the HF account instead). Backend PINNED to :deepinfra at enable time (2026-11-09): the probes showed auto-routing lands on DeepInfra anyway, and the pin keeps the billed rate deterministic at the seeded parity prices — same iron as the direct account, different billing pool, which is the point of this route. Prices seeded at DeepInfra direct parity (pass-through, unverified). Quality mirrored from deepinfra/deepseek-v4-flash. NON-SENSITIVE ONLY (spillway_sensitive_excluded): HF routes to third-party backends whose data posture varies by provider. Deployed DISABLED 2026-11-09 as a probe (owner approval 2026-11-09): enable only after the HF token lands as keys/huggingface.key and the benchmark battery passes. HF billing is pass-through (no markup) via the owner's HF account — a billing pool SEPARATE from the direct provider accounts. PROBE RESULT 2026-11-09: verified serving through the HF connector (HTTP 200, exact reply, usage estimated_cost $2.52e-06 on a 21-token call — pass-through at DeepInfra parity). ENABLED 2026-11-09 on the owner's order, after fresh verification calls to both HF models passed. Tool-call and big-payload behaviour via HF is proven on the Cerebras entry (same router path); this entry itself was small-turn verified.

Direct Cerebras (api.cerebras.ai) — added 2026-11-12 on the owner's order after the HF-passthrough route to the same backend was disabled 2026-11-11. PROBE 2026-11-12 (direct key): plain turn 200 in 0.22s; substantive prompt reasoning 108 tokens default vs 42 at reasoning_effort=low, finish=stop both — the HF route's unbounded-reasoning fault (2,268 tokens, finish=length) does NOT reproduce direct; tool call well-formed; 41k-token prompt served in 1.7s; output speed ~2,500 tok/s (fastest in the registry). Reasoning can be damped via reasoning_effort (low/medium/high only — 'none' is a 400, and a reasoning:{enabled:false} body is a 400) — hence extra_body pins effort=low; the gateway must not expect reasoning fully off here. KEY TIER: the owner's key is on Cerebras' trial terms ($5 signup credit, 30-day expiry, 5 RPM / 90K TPM / 1M TPD, 65K context — Cerebras retired its permanent free tier 2026-07-16; the 'permanent free tier' claim in circulation is stale). Limits + context in this entry are the TRIAL figures: if the owner funds the account (pay-as-you-go $0.35/$0.75), raise context_tokens to 131072 and lift the limits. NON-SENSITIVE ONLY (spillway_sensitive_excluded): Cerebras' Developer tier is documented as not intended for production use and trial-tier data posture is unverified. Quality mirrored from groq/gpt-oss-120b (same weights). FIX 2026-11-12: base_url added after first deploy — without it the gateway has no default URL for the new cerebras provider and skips it as upstream_unreachable.

Novita AI direct — added 2026-11-12 (owner-supplied key). Cheapest gpt-oss-120b route seen anywhere: price seeded from Hugging Face's inference catalog listing of Novita's rate (read 2026-11-09, $0.05 in / $0.25 out per 1M) — NOT yet verified against Novita's own price list; correct on first console check. PROBE 2026-11-12: chat 200 in 1.0s, tool call well-formed in 0.9s (their /v3/openai/models listing 404s; chat completions path works). NON-SENSITIVE ONLY (spillway_sensitive_excluded): third-party compute host, data posture unverified. Quality mirrored from groq/gpt-oss-120b (same weights).

Z.ai's genuinely-free Flash tier — added 2026-11-12. Price $0 for input, cached input AND output on Z.ai's official pricing page (docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing, verified via multiple sources 2026-11-12); serves on the EXISTING zai key (no new account). 30B-A3B model, 200K context — the free lane's largest context after dots-3. PROBE 2026-11-12: served 200 on retry; the free tier throttles hard under load (HTTP 429 code 1305 'temporarily overloaded' on 2 of 3 attempts, ~21s latency when queued) and tool-calling is UNVERIFIED (every tool attempt hit the throttle; its sibling glm-4.5-flash served but returned text instead of a tool call — do not rely on this entry for tool turns until proven). The cascade skips on 429, so a throttled free entry costs nothing but a skip line. Lane public-free: $0 tier, data posture weakest — never eligible for sensitive traffic. Quality seeded modest (Flash tier): fine for extraction, classification, summarization and long-context reading; not a chat/code lead.

ENABLED 2026-11-12 (paid lane, real prices) — the staged free-tier premise died at the console: Mistral's Free plan includes a $10/mo API allowance but the API Keys page is locked ('Upgrade to activate your API keys'); there is no free route to a key and no phone verification exists (stale roundup research, corrected from the live console 2026-11-12). The owner approved the minimum $10 prepaid credit purchase the same day; pay-as-you-go is ACTIVE on the Launch Collective, LLC account (Google sign-in, jordan.mason@launchcollective.org) and the key is installed as secrets/mistral.key. Probes from VM103: plain turn + finish=stop clean. Prices are Mistral's published PAYG rates for mistral-large-latest ($2.00 in / $6.00 out per 1M, seeded 2026-11-12 — verify against the first invoice). Paid API traffic is not used for training under Mistral's API terms, so the free-tier training concern no longer applies; the entry is still spillway_sensitive_excluded on the third-party-hosting rule, same as HF/Cerebras/Novita. Limits are conservative seeds — read the account's real Limits page before raising. EU-hosted (diversity value).

ENABLED 2026-11-12 (paid lane, real prices) with mistral/mistral-large — same account, same $10 owner-approved pay-as-you-go activation, same key (secrets/mistral.key); see that entry for the full record. Probes from VM103: plain turn clean, tool call well-formed (finish=tool_calls). Prices are Mistral's published PAYG rates for codestral-latest ($0.30 in / $0.90 out per 1M, seeded 2026-11-12 — verify against the first invoice). The cascade's dedicated code specialist at the quality-5 tier.

ENABLED 2026-11-12 on the owner's AI Studio key (project 'Default Gemini Project', key name SovereignRouter, Free tier). MODEL REALITY CHECK 2026-11-12: gemini-2.5-flash 404s for new users (Google's error message itself names gemini-3.8-flash as the replacement) — BUT 3.8-flash timed out at 60s AND 120s on trivial probes from VM103 while 3.5-flash-lite answered twice in ~1.5s, so this entry runs the LITE model; revisit 3.8-flash when it responds like a production model. POSTURE: Google's pricing table marks the free tier 'used to improve our products: Yes' (human review included) — public-only-free PERMANENTLY; the paid tier flips that to No. Limits seeded conservatively (Google no longer publishes fixed tables; live per-project limits at aistudio.google.com/rate-limit). 1M context = the free lane's long-context lead (quality long-context 5); other classes seeded at Lite-tier 3. Served via Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

ENABLED 2026-11-12 — the owner supplied a Workers-AI-scoped API token (installed as secrets/cloudflare.key; Cloudflare's verify endpoint reports it active). Probes from VM103 before enabling: plain turn exact-match with finish=stop, tool call well-formed; tiny 48-token probe budgets starve on reasoning tokens, normal budgets are clean. Observed cost ~5.8 neurons for a 125-token turn. Free allocation: 10,000 Neurons/day account-wide (resets 00:00 UTC) — on gpt-oss-120b pricing (31,818 neurons/M in, 68,182/M out) that is roughly 150-270 typical turns/day: a bonus rung, not a lane. Price fields are $0 because the free allocation is what this entry exists to spend; past it, Workers Free hard-fails (no overage without the $5/mo Paid plan). Third billing pool for the same gpt-oss-120b weights (after Groq + Cerebras). Posture: Cloudflare's no-training stance was NOT re-verified from a primary source in this pass, so public-only-free until it is. Quality mirrored from groq/gpt-oss-120b.

ENABLED 2026-11-12 with cloudflare/gpt-oss-120b — same owner-supplied Workers AI token (verify endpoint: active). Probes: plain turn exact-match, tool call well-formed — tool-calling is PROVEN for this route (and Cloudflare's catalog describes the model as optimized for multi-turn tool calling). Context corrected at enable time to Cloudflare's catalog value: 131,072 (the staged seed carried Z.ai's 200K figure). Observed cost ~1.4 neurons for a small turn. Same 10,000-Neuron daily pool (shared account-wide; GLM-4.7-Flash is cheaper per turn: 5,500 neurons/M in, 36,400/M out, so ~700 small turns/day if it had the pool to itself). A second, steadier route to the same free GLM Flash weights as zai/glm-4.7-flash — Z.ai's own free endpoint throttled hard during the 2026-11-12 probes (429 code 1305); Cloudflare's pool is the failover for it (same pattern as DeepInfra/HF Flash). Quality mirrors zai/glm-4.7-flash; this route is the steadier of the two (Z.ai throttles).
